name: Toorisugari no Satsui
source:
Main character goes with university friends on a drive during summer vacations. At the parking spot young people meet, and incident happens.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-july-2007-bullet-butlers.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
暑假期间，主角与大学朋友一起开车兜风。年轻人在停车场相遇，随后发生了一起意外。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-july-2007-bullet-butlers.html]vndbreview[/url]]
